name: Black Locust
caution: Eat ONLY the white flowers. The bark, leaves, seeds, and pods of black locust are toxic. Be sure of the tree and use the blossoms only. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: Drooping clusters of sweet-pea-shaped white flowers scent whole roadsides for a week or two in spring. Every other part of the tree is off the menu.

sections.title: In the kitchen
sections.body: The blossoms are honey-sweet raw and classic dipped in batter and fried into fritters.
